title: Diagnostic Fee Share by Failed Component, Harbison Labor-Only Protection Tiers
content:
On a Harbison Protection Contracts contract on the Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or the Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection, the share of the visit's diagnostic fee paid on a claim depends on the failed component named on the claim.

| Failed component | Diagnostic share |
|---|---|
| heat exchanger, gas valve, flame sensor, igniter or pressure switch (safety components) | 1.00 |
| blower motor, inducer motor, condenser fan motor, control board or defrost board (motors and boards) | 0.50 |
| any other component | the tier's own diagnostic coverage: one where the tier covers the diagnostic fee, zero where it does not |

**How the share is applied.** The diagnostic payable is the diagnostic net multiplied by the diagnostic share, and it is paid only on the lead claim of the service call — the claim whose failed component carries the largest repair labor line charged on that call. The diagnostic net is the diagnostic fee charged on the claim's service call less the member diagnostic rate posted against it.

**Cases (hypothetical, diagnostic net $100.00 on the lead claim).**

| Failed component | Share | Diagnostic payable |
|---|---|---|
| flame sensor | 1.00 | $100.00 |
| defrost board | 0.50 | $50.00 |
| capacitor, on a tier that does not cover the diagnostic fee | zero | $0.00 |
| igniter, but the claim is not the lead claim of its call | 1.00 | $0.00 (not the lead claim) |
